title: Studio tools for independent music teachers
subtitle: Expertise run for a piano teacher who builds in Next.js: scheduling, makeups, billing and practice tracking for solo studios.

founder.channel: online; member of music teacher forums and Facebook groups

verdict.summary: The admin pain is real, but it's covered. Teachers complain about makeups, reschedules and late tuition, yet My Music Staff already does makeup credits, self-rescheduling and auto-invoicing for $16.95/mo, Nova is free up to 10 students, and many teachers say Venmo and Excel are enough. The best open gap, practice logs that teachers can correct, comes from three reviews of a single app, in a niche whose best-known app (Tonara) shut down in 2023. Caveat: Capterra, G2, Trustpilot and Reddit were blocked from this network, so complaints about incumbents on those sites weren't read.

opportunities.name: Editable practice log companion
opportunities.one_liner: Assignment and practice tracking where teachers and parents can fix the minutes.
opportunities.why: pain 5: three different Practice Space reviewers ask to edit or enter practice time (e17, e18, e19), and Tonara's shutdown forced teachers to switch (e28, e29, e31), but it's one app and no one is leaving over it. willingness_to_pay 4: the one paying reviewer says it isn't worth the fee (e20), and Tonara couldn't survive (e41). competition_gap 4: the complaint is specific to Practice Space; My Music Staff and Nova also offer practice tracking (vendor claims). founder_fit 9: a small web app a teacher-developer can build and use with their own students. reachability 7: Piano World, Piano Pantry and the founder's own groups (e42 and e43 show the forum bans ads). build_cost 7: a few weeks at 10 hours a week.

opportunities.name: All-in-one studio manager for solo teachers
opportunities.one_liner: Scheduling, makeup credits, billing and practice in one app.
opportunities.why: pain 6: makeups, reschedules and late payments come up again and again, from many authors across a decade of forum threads (e2, e3, e4, e5, e7, e8, e9, e10, e11). It's weekly admin friction, not churn. willingness_to_pay 5: teachers do move to paid software as they grow (e1), but many say doing it for free is easy (e21, e22, e23, e24) and are cutting subscriptions (e25, e26). competition_gap 2: My Music Staff already does exactly what teachers ask for (e27) at $16.95/mo (e32), and Nova is free up to 10 students (e34). build_cost 4: recurring billing, family portals and scheduling would take months at 10 hours a week.

opportunities.name: Monthly tuition and makeup-credit calculator
opportunities.one_liner: Works out fair monthly tuition across 4- and 5-lesson months, holidays and credits.
opportunities.why: pain 6: tuition math with variable months is a long-running argument among teachers (e13, e14, e15, e16, e12). willingness_to_pay 2: it's a calculation teachers already do in spreadsheets or let their studio software handle (e22, e27). It works as a free lead magnet, not a product.

gap.statement: Teachers who track student practice in an app can't fix a wrong or missing practice log, because Practice Space, the timer-only app many moved to after Tonara closed, doesn't allow edits.

pains.theme: Makeups and reschedules eat admin time
pains.summary: Weekly texting and rearranging, and pushback from parents. Teachers resist no-makeup policies.
Parents pay late or after the fact, and reminders happen outside Venmo.

pains.theme: Monthly tuition math with 4- and 5-lesson months
pains.summary: Flat monthly fees with a variable number of lessons cause confusion and disputes.
With a timer-only log, a forgotten stop button or a bug corrupts the record and the streak.
This is a counter-signal: Excel, Venmo, QuickBooks and Notion are called sufficient, and teachers are auditing their subscriptions.

critic.risk: Tried and died: Tonara, the best-known student practice and assignment app, shut down on December 8, 2023.
Free incumbents: Nova is free up to 10 students and $10/mo after that; My Music Staff is $16.95. There's no room to undercut on price.
Pain without payment: teachers call free tools sufficient, and the one paying practice-app reviewer says the app isn't worth the fee.
Copyable in a week: an 'edit practice time' feature is small for Practice Space or My Music Staff to ship.
Channel: Piano World bans advertising, and most teacher Facebook groups likely do too.
critic.rebuttal: The founder is already a member of these groups. Helpful answers without links, plus direct questions to peers, are allowed (e42, e43 show the rule).

critic.risk: Evidence gap: Capterra, G2, Trustpilot, GetApp, Software Advice and Reddit were blocked, so complaints about incumbents there weren't read.

win_plan.positioning: Practice logs your students can't break: you fix the minutes, they keep the streak.

switching_triggers.move: Offer to import assignment history for free when the next one closes

offers: Teacher and parent can edit any log entry

build_first.feature: Edit practice time and date after the fact
build_first.why: pain: practice logs can't be corrected (e17, e18)

build_first.feature: Manual practice entry without a timer

where_to_find.why: Ten-plus years of threads on makeups, tuition and software. No ads allowed.
Teachers shared their Tonara transition plans here

where_to_find.place: Founder's own music teacher Facebook groups
where_to_find.why: The founder is already a member. Ask questions there, don't post promotions.

stop_doing: Posting promotional links in teacher forums

pricing.recommendation: If tested: free for up to 10 students, then $3-5/mo
pricing.rationale: Solo-studio tools are already $0-17/mo, and teachers are cutting subscriptions. A practice add-on only works priced well below the studio tool it sits next to.

validation.experiment: Before writing code, ask 15 teachers in your own groups who use Practice Space or a studio tool's practice log whether broken logs cost them time, and whether they'd pay $3-5/mo to fix it.
validation.pass_bar: 8 of 15 say it happens weekly and 3 ask to try it
steps: Day 1: write a 3-question ask with no link
Days 2-4: send it to 15 teachers you know from your groups
Day 5: count weekly-pain answers and asks to try

kill_criteria: Fewer than 5 of 15 report broken practice logs as a weekly problem
Teachers say the My Music Staff or Nova practice log already does this
